models_evaluated: LLM (3 other models, not named in abstract)

links.outcome: Consistency of LLM answers with pharmacist responses on real outpatient queries
links.effect: LLMs showed 84.85%-89.09% consistency with pharmacists' responses; discrepancies arose from incomplete pharmacist documentation, LLM drug misidentification, and differences in practical medication advice.
links.quote: The LLMs demonstrated high consistency with pharmacists' responses, with rates of 84.85%-89.09%.

links.outcome: LLM responses compared against pharmacist answers on the same queries
links.effect: Four LLMs compared with pharmacists' answers; consistency 84.85%-89.09%; DeepSeek R1 achieved 3-4-point scores in 137 queries.
links.quote: In scored evaluations, DeepSeek R1 achieved the highest score, achieving 3-4-point scores in 137 queries by integrating multi-perspective drug analysis and actionable administration strategies.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance and accuracy of 4 LLMs on 165 real-world drug-drug interaction queries compared to pharmacist answers, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
